load_monotonic_decoder_config: load the monotonic decoder config from the asset store using the config loader
load_monotonic_decoder_model: load a monotonic decoder model checkpoint from fairseq2 asset store with download manager
convert_monotonic_checkpoint: convert a fairseq monotonic decoder checkpoint to fairseq2 format with key remapping
remap_checkpoint_keys: remap fairseq decoder key names to fairseq2 text_decoder key names in a checkpoint
fix_embedding_positions: fix control symbol embedding positions and remove dummy tokens from NLLB-100 checkpoints
